{"source":"import Base

type Column is Data:
  Column{north: U32, life: U32, south: U32}

def Life.stencil(west: Column, center: Column, east: Column) -> U32:
  match west center east:
    case Column{nw, w, sw} Column{n, alive, s} Column{ne, e, se}:
      +neighbors = (nw + n + ne + w + e + sw + s + se : U32)
      Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(neighbors, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(alive, 1), U32.is_eq(neighbors, 2))))

def Halo.pop(row: List<&2, U32>) -> U32 & List<&2, U32>:
  match row:
    case Nil{}:
      (0, Nil{})
    case head <> tail:
      (head, tail)

def Life.line(
  cells: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  below: List<&2, U32>,
  west: Column,
  +center: Column
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Life.stencil(west, center, Column{0, 0, 0}) <> Nil{}
    case right <> rest:
      (right_up, above2) = Halo.pop(above)
      (right_down, below2) = Halo.pop(below)
      +east = Column{right_up, right, right_down}
      Life.stencil(west, center, east) <>
        Life.line(rest, above2, below2, center, east)

def Life.row(
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  current: List<&2, U32>,
  below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match current:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case alive <> rest:
      (up, above2) = Halo.pop(above)
      (down, below2) = Halo.pop(below)
      Life.line(
        rest, above2, below2,
        Column{0, 0, 0}, Column{up, alive, down})

def Rows.cut(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width) <>
        Rows.cut(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

def Life.rows(
  rest: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>,
  zero: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  +current: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rest:
    case Nil{}:
      Life.row(above, current, zero)
    case +below <> tail:
      List.append(&2, U32,
        Life.row(above, current, below),
        Life.rows(tail, zero, current, below))

def Life.enter(
  +zero: List<&2, U32>,
  rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case current <> rest:
      Life.rows(rest, zero, zero, current)

def step(
  width: U32,
  height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +w = U32.to_nat(width)
  Life.enter(
    List.replicate(U32, w, 0),
    Rows.cut(U32.to_nat(height), w, cells))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat,
  +width: U32,
  +height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"Read the board as a stream of vertical three-cell Columns. Zero halos above and below, plus dead Columns at each line end, collapse finite-boundary handling into the same sliding three-column stencil used for every interior cell. Chunking and ordered concatenation preserve the original row-major representation.","findings":"none (initial submission)"}
